title: Mise shop departments
description: Departments of the shopping list (spec §6.14), in display order. A line goes to the department of its best-matching keyword (spec §11.7): whole word first, then the end of a compound word (the Dutch head: 'paprikapoeder' is a poeder), then the start ('uien', 'kippendijen'); a longer keyword beats a shorter one. Vegetables from vegetables.json always count as groente and need no keywords here. 'overig' is the fallback and has none. Labels are string resources shopping_department_<id with _>.
